name: v0.17.2
body:
Release v0.17.2

Validator migration required. Run `miden-validator migrate`.

## Breaking Changes

- **Validator:** Validator database migration links validated transactions to the signed block that includes them. (#2531)
- **Validator:** Replace the out-of-band DKG ceremony with a p2p-via-relay (#2729)

## Changes by Scope

### General

- **Changed:** `miden-usdcx-genesis` builds the genesis USDCx faucet with the V2 token policy manager, so pausing the faucet no longer blocks fee payments. (#2743)

### RPC

- **Changed:** HTTP/2 and TCP keep-alives have been enabled on all gRPC servers to detect disconnected or unresponsive peers. (#2728)

### Node

- **Added:** Support mainnet bootstrap and network selection for full-node sync with --network. (#2744)

### NTX Builder

- **Added:** Support mainnet bootstrap with --network mainnet. (#2744)

### Validator

- **Breaking:** Validator database migration links validated transactions to the signed block that includes them. (#2531)
- **Breaking:** Replace the out-of-band DKG ceremony with a p2p-via-relay (#2729)
- **Added:** GET /admin/v1/transactions/{tx_id} returns one validated transaction's full sealed record by id. (#2532)
- **Changed:** The validator admin transaction listing is paginated (strict keyset pages in committed order, PaginationInfo-style cursor) and returns metadata-only items unless full records are requested; admin paths moved under /admin/v1/. (#2532)
- **Changed:** The validator admin decryption-share endpoint refuses to issue shares for transactions the validator has not itself validated. (#2533)
- **Fixed:** The validator status no longer counts a replacement of the tip block as an additional signed block. (#2531)

### Network Monitor

- **Added:** Added `--faucet-mint-amount` (`MIDEN_MONITOR_FAUCET_MINT_AMOUNT`) to set the amount each faucet check requests, defaulting to 1,000 base units. (#2742)
- **Added:** Monitor multiple named validators with independent health checks in a shared dashboard card. (#2745)
- **Added:** Display funding service status, account balance, native asset metadata, and request limits. (#2745)
- **Changed:** Display funding service and faucet amounts in tokens using the asset's decimal precision. (#2745)
